text:
```yaml
name: Danger Comment

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]

jobs:
  danger:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - name: Danger PR Comment
        uses: danger/danger-js@main
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
